title: Open-immersion restriction preserves finite limits and K-injectives
statement: For an open immersion $j:X\to Y$ of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion], ordinary module restriction [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] preserves finite limits and sends every K-injective complex [def-pur-kinjective-complex] termwise to a K-injective complex. No boundedness or quasi-coherence hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Preservation of finite limits is the existing source-library instance preservesLimitsOfSize_restrictFunctor [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-limits]. Additivity is checked sectionwise by extensionality and rfl.

Factor j through its image open using isoOpensRange. Restriction along the isomorphism is an equivalence: its inverse is restriction along the inverse isomorphism, and restrictFunctorComp, restrictFunctorCongr and restrictFunctorId supply the unit and counit. The equivalence preserves K-injectives.

The overFunctor on the image open preserves K-injectives by kInjective_of_restrict_open [lem-sc-derived-k-injective-restrict-open]. Compose it with overEquiv and the preceding restriction equivalence. overFunctorEquiv and restrictFunctorComp identify this composite with restriction along j; transport K-injective preservation through the natural isomorphism.
